actions.input:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - << 'PY'
import pandas as pd
import re

file='national_programme_ledger.xlsx'

# Load
fe_raw=pd.read_excel(file, sheet_name='Field Expenses', header=None)
sal_raw=pd.read_excel(file, sheet_name='Salary Register', header=None)
lookup_raw=pd.read_excel(file, sheet_name='Cost Centre Lookup', header=None)

fe_header = fe_raw.iloc[4].tolist()
fe_data = fe_raw.iloc[5:].reset_index(drop=True)
fe_data.columns = fe_header
fe_data.columns = [str(c).strip() if pd.notna(c) else '' for c in fe_data.columns]

sal_header = sal_raw.iloc[5].tolist()
sal_data = sal_raw.iloc[6:].reset_index(drop=True)
sal_data.columns = sal_header
sal_data.columns = [str(c).strip() if pd.notna(c) else '' for c in sal_data.columns]

lookup_header = lookup_raw.iloc[3].tolist()
lookup_data = lookup_raw.iloc[4:].reset_index(drop=True)
lookup_data.columns = lookup_header
lookup_data.columns = [str(c).strip() if pd.notna(c) else '' for c in lookup_data.columns]

# Clean lookup mapping
lookup_data = lookup_data.dropna(subset=['Cost Centre Code'])
# Normalize cost centre code
lookup_data['code_norm'] = lookup_data['Cost Centre Code'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
# Build mapping code_norm -> district
code_to_district = dict(zip(lookup_data['code_norm'], lookup_data['District']))

def parse_amount(val):
    if pd.isna(val):
        return 0
    s = str(val).strip()
    # Remove ₹ and commas
    s = s.replace('₹','').replace(',','').strip()
    # Might be numeric
    try:
        return float(s)
    except:
        # try extract numbers
        m = re.search(r'[\\d\\.]+', s)
        if m:
            try:
                return float(m.group())
            except:
                return 0
    return 0

# Process field expenses
fe_data = fe_data.dropna(subset=['Cost Centre','Posting Status','Amount (INR)'])
fe_data['cost_norm'] = fe_data['Cost Centre'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
fe_data['status_norm'] = fe_data['Posting Status'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
fe_data = fe_data[fe_data['status_norm']=='posted']
fe_data['amount'] = fe_data['Amount (INR)'].apply(parse_amount)
# Keep only codes in lookup
fe_data = fe_data[fe_data['cost_norm'].isin(code_to_district)]
fe_data['district'] = fe_data['cost_norm'].map(code_to_district)

# Process salary
sal_data = sal_data.dropna(subset=['Cost Centre','Payroll Status','Gross Salary (INR)'])
sal_data['cost_norm'] = sal_data['Cost Centre'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
sal_data['status_norm'] = sal_data['Payroll Status'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
sal_data = sal_data[sal_data['status_norm']=='paid']
sal_data['amount'] = sal_data['Gross Salary (INR)'].apply(parse_amount)
sal_data = sal_data[sal_data['cost_norm'].isin(code_to_district)]
sal_data['district'] = sal_data['cost_norm'].map(code_to_district)

# Sum per district
fe_sum = fe_data.groupby('district')['amount'].sum()
sal_sum = sal_data.groupby('district')['amount'].sum()

combined = fe_sum.add(sal_sum, fill_value=0)
combined = combined.sort_values(ascending=False)

print('Field expenses sum per district:')
print(fe_sum)
print('\\nSalary sum per district:')
print(sal_sum)
print('\\nCombined:')
print(combined)

top_district = combined.idxmax()
top_value = combined.max()
print('\\nTop district:', top_district, top_value)
PY"
